title: Play restriction 'I can't be played on your first, second, or third turns' is not enforced
expected: ven.json:1145-1163 defines ven-029-166 (Ol' Poro) with rulesText "I can't be played on your first, second, or third turns." but abilities:[] and parseSuccess:false, so no restriction exists in the card definition. The engine's play gate (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/play-restrictions.ts:69 playIsForbidden) only enforces static restrict-play abilities pulled from the registry; with an empty abilities array nothing forbids the play, and there is no turnsTaken-based self play restriction anywhere in the engine (turnsTaken is only consulted in scoring-rules.ts and a static-abilities condition). playUnit is therefore offered and succeeds on turn 1.
observed: On turn 1 main phase `pw moves` listed playUnit for player-1-main-999-ven-029-166 and executing it succeeded: energy 6->4, Ol' Poro (might 4) entered base. Set data ven.json shows parseSuccess:false, abilities:[] for this card, so no restriction exists in the definition.
